metaTitre: Reef Notes, a working notebook from an independent web studio
metaDescription: Build logs, load times, typography and the business of running a small web studio. Written in English and French, a few notes a month, by the three people doing the work.
titre: Notes from a small web studio
chapeau: What we learn building sites, written down as we go. The notebook, not the portfolio.

studio.title: The studio behind the notes
studio.lede: One builds, one measures, one designs, and all three write. Three or four projects a year, and everything we learn on them ends up here.

dernieresNotes.title: Latest notes
dernieresNotes.lede: The most recent entries, newest first. Everything older waits in the archive.

sujets.title: Five threads we keep pulling
sujets.lede: Every post belongs to exactly one topic, so a thread can be read end to end without wading through the rest.

signatures.title: Who writes here
signatures.lede: Everyone here still ships client work. Each byline leads to everything that person has published, oldest note included.
